title: Generated routes and repositories enforce caller authority
statement: Every generated HTTP handler MUST have a unique exact resource-operation permission key and run behind host-installed STYNX authentication and PermissionGuard; generated writes MUST reject untrusted tenant and primary-key values and use app-role Database.tx, trusted tenant and actor context, bound query values, and tenant-scoped SQL.
rationale: A generated route must not infer authority from a path or body, and an app transaction must fail when caller context is missing.

strategy.rationale: Controller structural tests enumerate all routes and permission metadata; packed Nest route tests deny and allow each operation and reject invalid DTOs; repository tests probe bound parameters, missing context, and cross-tenant updates and deletes.
